author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am willing to accept the rollback process to the serving endpoint remaining manual. Keeping that specific step done by hand ensures the live pipeline stays stable during the shadow run. I will not automate the rollback mechanism right now. If we force full automation on that path, we risk destabilizing the current serving infrastructure. I am trading the convenience of an automated rollback for the certainty that the existing forecast delivery does not break. The shadow environment can be fully automated and governed as requested, but the exit path back to the live endpoint must stay under human control to protect operational stability.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are trading the convenience of an automated rollback for the certainty that the existing forecast delivery remains stable.
